description: Corncomp is a paper food box manufacturer and wholesale paper food box supplier based in Ningbo, China, producing FSC-certified takeaway paper boxes for foodservice distributors, restaurant chains, catering companies, and retail buyers worldwide. Below is our current paper food box collection, along with manufacturing, customization, and B2B ordering details for buyers sourcing paper food boxes wholesale, in bulk, or as custom paper food boxes. See our Biodegradable Food Packaging Manufacturer page for our full product range. Paper Food Box Manufacturer in China. As a paper food box manufacturer in China, Corncomp produces paper food boxes factory-direct at our own GMP-standard facility in Ningbo, giving wholesale and bulk buyers direct factory pricing, consistent quality control, and the ability to customize paper food boxes for private label and OEM/ODM programs. See our Food Packaging Manufacturer in China page for more on our export markets and buyer support. Manufacturing and Production Capacity: Paper food boxes are produced across dedicated forming and packaging lines inside Corncomp's 8,000m² manufacturing base, including a 6,000m² GMP-standard dust-free workshop. Production process control is independently audited by SGS. Full factory details, machinery, and process flow are on our Factory and Manufacturing page. Product Types: Kraft Food Box with PP Handle; Square Food Box with Wire Handle (White Cardboard); Doner Box; and Natural Kraft Menu Box. Corncomp also manufactures a wider range of related takeaway paper packaging, including hamburger boxes, sandwich boxes, wrap boxes, sushi boxes, pizza slice boxes, fries cones, and salad boxes — see our Hamburger Box / Wrap Box / Sandwich Box / Pizza Slice and Salad Box categories for the full range. Customization: Custom printing (logos, packaging designs) is available on paper food boxes using food-safe water-based ink. Several box styles are offered with a PLA window for product visibility while keeping the box body FSC-certified paper. Contact us with your box style, size, and printing requirements for a customization recommendation. Material & Certification Options: Natural Kraft Menu Box — kraft paper; DIN CERTCO Certified Compostable, Reg. No. 7P1802, held by affiliated manufacturer Ningbo Millionpack Co., Ltd. for this specific Natural Kraft Paper Food Container specification Doner Box — kraft/cardboard paper; FSC Chain of Custody component Square Food Box Wire Handle (White Cardboard) — white cardboard body under FSC Chain of Custody; wire handle is a functional component without a compostability claim Kraft Food Box PP Handle — kraft paper body under FSC Chain of Custody; PP handle is a functional component without a compostability claim; any PLA window is certified separately under BPI (ASTM D6400) For full certificate numbers and verification links, see our Certifications page. B2B Information: Standard MOQ is 30,000 units per item, or 50,000 units per item for custom-printed paper food boxes. Standard lead time is approximately 30 days from order confirmation, factory-direct with no middleman. Samples are available ahead of a bulk order — contact us with your requirements to arrange samples. Corncomp ships paper food boxes wholesale to Europe, the USA, Canada, Australia, and South-East Asia, with local support from offices in Belgium and New York. Custom printing, custom packaging, and private label / OEM/ODM programs are available for bulk paper food box orders. For full B2B ordering details, see our Custom Food Packaging Manufacturer guide. Certification: Corncomp's paper food boxes are manufactured to ISO 9001:2015, FSC Chain of Custody, and BRC Global Standard for Packaging Materials certifications, and are tested to FDA, LFGB, and EU AP 2002 food-contact standards. FSC certification applies to the kraft/cardboard paper components; PP handles and wire handles are functional components without compostability claims. Boxes with a PLA window use PLA certified compostable under BPI (ASTM D6400) for that component. Corncomp's Natural Kraft Menu Box is manufactured to the Natural Kraft Paper Food Container specification that is DIN CERTCO certified for industrial compostability (DIN EN 13432, ASTM D6400) through Corncomp's affiliated manufacturing entity, Ningbo Millionpack Co., Ltd.; this certification applies to that certified specification, not to every box style in this category. See certificate numbers and verification links on our Certifications page. Ready to order? Request a Bulk Quote | Request Samples | Ask About Custom Printing & OEM/ODM In short: Corncomp is a paper food box manufacturer and wholesale supplier in Ningbo, China, producing FSC-certified kraft and cardboard takeaway food boxes — including menu boxes, hamburger boxes, sandwich boxes, and pizza boxes — with custom printing and private label / OEM/ODM options — for foodservice distributors, restaurant chains, catering companies, and retail buyers sourcing paper food boxes in bulk worldwide.
